bio: This restaurant housed in an 18C building has a warm, rustic feel with terracotta, stone and brick decor and black tables with American-style place mats, resulting in a vibrant yet elegant atmosphere where the service is informal and yet also highly professional. The cuisine is inspired by regional recipes which are reinterpreted and given a lighter flavour. There’s no shortage of interesting fish dishes, including the exquisite red shrimp, which is half-cooked, half-raw and served with passion-fruit caramel....
